title: Massacre at the Onderon Temple
summary: Dark Jedi storm a Jedi temple on Onderon and cut down the Jedi gathered in its great hall. The players, hidden in a side corridor, can only watch; afterwards they search the ruin and find one survivor.
gmNotes: Run beats 1-4 back to back with a breath between them; let the fight play out before beat 4. The players are frozen until beat 5, and the dark Jedi can't target them while they are. In beat 5 the dark Jedi leave and the players are free: the survivor gives them their lead.

area.reason: KotOR's Dantooine Jedi Enclave is the best Jedi-temple interior: a great central hall (m13aa_02a, 35x35 m) with corridors off it, which plays as the Onderon temple.

players.note: In the east corridor (m13aa_02h), looking west into the great hall.

actors.name: Master Vanar
actors.bark: Stay hidden. Whatever happens, you must live to tell the Order.

actors.name: Padawan Lira
actors.bark: They took the holocrons... they're going to Dxun.

beats.title: Evening at the temple
beats.narration: Lamplight fills the great hall. The masters speak quietly with their students; nobody notices you in the side corridor.

actions.text: The Council's warnings were right. Something is coming.

beats.title: The doors burst open
beats.narration: The great doors buckle and blow inward. Red blades ignite in the smoke.
beats.notes: Reveals the dark Jedi; they attack at once.

beats.title: The master stands alone
beats.notes: Once most of the knights are down. The padawans run, but there's nowhere to go.

beats.title: Fire and silence
beats.narration: Fires catch in the tapestries. The dark Jedi walk out the way they came, unhurried.

beats.title: Searching the ruin
beats.narration: The footsteps fade. You can move again.
beats.notes: The dark Jedi are gone. An Awareness check finds the survivor quickly; otherwise she calls out after a while.
